name: meeting-audio
description: Meeting-grade live caption, translation, and semi-realtime summary system.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,online -c blue,green "pnpm -F web dev" "pnpm -F online dev"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently --kill-others --names web,online,whl,offline -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm -F web dev" "pnpm -F online dev" "cd services/offline && uv run python run_whl.py" "cd services/offline && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload"
